id: 865-維京人對不列顛群島的入侵和佔領
theater: 肯特、東英格蘭、默西亞與約克

battle.name: 維京人對不列顛群島的入侵和佔領
battle.theater: 肯特、東英格蘭、默西亞與約克
battle.brief: 八六五年秋，維京大軍在東英格蘭登陸，以馬匹換和平，再沿北線取約克、奪諾丁漢，八六九年滅東英格蘭並殺其王；八七八年大軍奇襲奇彭漢姆，卻在伊丁頓敗於阿爾弗雷德。決定勝負的不是弓，而是斧與盾牆；卡面的亞述長弓只是同一譜系的遠祖。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 八六五年起侵入不列顛群島的北歐軍隊，在英格蘭編年史中稱為「偉大異教軍」（mycel hæþen here），主要由丹麥人組成，另有挪威人、瑞典人，以及在法蘭克與弗里西亞打過仗的老兵，後來還有自斯堪的納維亞與愛爾蘭來援的船隊。指揮體系不是常設國家，而是幾位首領各領一部、共享戰利品的聯盟：伊瓦·無骨、哈爾夫丹、烏巴三兄弟最為人知，此外還有巴格塞克、古斯魯姆、奧斯克泰爾與安文德等人，後世薩迦把這批人說成傳說中拉格納·洛德布洛克之子；英格蘭編年史明確記載參與者只有三人，其餘屬文學添加。英格蘭一方的交戰方是四個薩克遜王國：威塞克斯由艾塞爾伍爾夫父子執掌，後歸阿爾弗雷德；默西亞先後有伯格雷德與被扶植的西奧爾伍爾夫；東英格蘭的國王艾德蒙於八七〇年前後被殺；約克一帶的北安普敦則淪為大軍的附庸。法蘭克王國同樣被捲入：西法蘭克王查理二世·禿頭於八七七年去世，其子路易二世翌年病死，王位繼承危機使北歐貴族在萊茵與塞納河流域重獲活動空間，維京軍隊於八七九年越海轉戰大陸。戰役的地理範圍集中在英格蘭東岸與中部：肯特的薩尼特島是首個登陸點，東英格蘭的特特福德、默西亞的諾丁漢、托克西與雷普頓是先後出現的冬營，約克是佔領核心，西部則是威塞克斯的堡壘帶。
countriesEn: The northern force that invaded the British Isles from 865 is called the Great Heathen Army (mycel hæþen here) in the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle. It consisted mainly of Danes, together with Norwegians, Swedes and veterans who had already fought in Francia and Frisia, and later with fleets bringing reinforcements from Scandinavia and Ireland. Its command structure was not a standing state but a coalition of several leaders, each commanding a division and sharing out the spoils: the brothers Ivar the Boneless, Halfdan and Ubba are the best known, joined by Bagsecg, Guthrum, Oscetel and Anwend, while later sagas recast them as the sons of the legendary Ragnar Lodbrok. The Chronicle itself names only three participants, and the rest is literary embroidery. On the English side the belligerents were four Anglo-Saxon kingdoms: Wessex under Æthelwulf and his sons and then Alfred; Mercia under Burgred and later the imposed Ceolwulf; East Anglia, whose king Edmund was killed around 870; and Northumbria around York, which sank into dependence on the army. The Frankish kingdom was drawn in as well: Charles the Bald of West Francia died in 877 and his son Louis II died soon after, and the succession crisis gave the Norse great men room to operate again along the Rhine and the Seine, while a Viking force crossed to the continent in 879. The fighting stayed in eastern and central England. The Isle of Thanet in Kent was the first landing point; Thetford in East Anglia, Nottingham, Torksey and Repton in Mercia were successive winter camps; York became the centre of the occupation; and in the west lay the network of fortified towns that defended Wessex.
people: 維京一方的關鍵人物有數位。伊瓦·無骨是同時代記載中最清楚的首領，愛塞爾威爾德的編年史說他「自北方率艦隊來到英格蘭」，八六五至八七〇年間大軍的每一次調動都以他為核心；他其後在東英格蘭病逝，具體年份各抄本有異。哈爾夫丹活到最後，八七四年率一部北上諾森伯里，在泰恩河畔過冬，八七五年遠征蘇格蘭、與皮克特人及斯特拉斯克萊的布立吞人交戰，八七六年回到南方，把北安普敦的土地分給部眾耕種，這片土地後來成為丹麥法區的核心。烏巴在八六九年肯特戰役中戰死，十九世紀末以來肯特大路一帶的土丘一直被指認為他的墳塚。英格蘭方面的核心人物是阿爾弗雷德。他是艾塞爾伍爾夫之子艾塞爾雷德的弟弟，八七一年一月初八在阿什當之役中以少量兵力擊敗自斯堪的納維亞趕來的「大夏軍」，斬殺其統帥巴格塞克；同年四月艾塞爾雷德去世，他繼位為王，隨即以金錢贖回北方。八七八年一月大軍奇襲奇彭漢姆、焚毀王宮，他被迫逃亡沃爾；五月在伊丁頓取勝，再以韋德莫爾條約令古斯魯姆受洗並退出威塞克斯。他傳世的記述來自修士阿塞爾，是這十三年最接近當時的可靠記錄。其餘值得記住的名字：東英格蘭王艾德蒙在特特福德兵敗被擒殺，後世稱殉道者；默西亞王伯格雷德於八七四年被驅往海外；被扶植的西奧爾伍爾夫在編年史中被貶為「愚蠢王的家臣」；北安普敦的叛臣托斯蒂格在八六五年投向大軍，最後死在阿什當的戰場上。
peopleEn: Several individuals stand out on the Norse side. Ivar the Boneless is the best documented leader of the age: the chronicler Æthelweard records that the fleets of Ivar landed in England from the north, and every move the army made between 865 and 870 was made around him. He later died of illness in East Anglia, though the surviving manuscripts differ about the year. Halfdan lasted longest. In 874 he led one division north into Northumbria and wintered by the river Tyne; in 875 he ravaged Scotland and fought the Picts and the Britons of Strathclyde; and in 876 he came back south of the border and shared out the land of Northumbria among his men, who ploughed it and supported themselves. That share-out is the origin of the core of the Danelaw. Ubba was killed in the Kent fighting of 869, and a mound beside the great Kentish road has long been identified as his burial. The central figure on the English side is Alfred. Brother of Æthelred, son of Æthelwulf, he defeated the reinforced Great Summer Army that had come from Scandinavia at Ashdown on 8 January 871, killing its commander Bagsecg; when Æthelred died three months later Alfred succeeded and promptly bought the Danes off with money. When the army raided Chippenham in January 878, burned the royal house and drove Alfred into hiding at Wareham, he came back in May to win at Edington, and then forced Guthrum to be baptised and leave Wessex under the terms of Wedmore. The record of all this comes from Asser, whose account is the closest thing to a contemporary witness for these thirteen years. Other names worth remembering: Edmund of East Anglia, defeated and killed after his attack on the army at Thetford, later honoured as Edmund the Martyr; Burgred, king of Mercia, driven overseas in 874; Ceolwulf, the imposed Mercian ruler, whom the Chronicle dismisses as a foolish king's thegn; and Tostig of Northumbria, who threw in his lot with the army in 865 and died on the field of Ashdown.
kits: 卡面上的亞述長弓屬於前七世紀亞述帝國的車上弓兵體系：木胎貼角製成，張力大而箭速平穩，弓手站在雙輪輕車上以平射壓住對面陣線，車兵再趁隙插入，最後由重步兵完成殘殺。這套武器在一八六五年的英格蘭完全不存在——它屬於西亞的兵器譜系，而北歐人手中的是另一支：斯堪的納維亞的短弓，榆木或白蠗木弓身，鹿角與筋腱加固的複合弓在北歐亦有使用，箭則是骨或石製的散箭。維京人在戰場上並不以弓箭為主戰兵種，其投射武器主要用於船上的追獵、騷擾與偵察，真正決定陣地爭奪的是雙手斧、長矛與圓盾，薩迦也把「拉格納之子」的裝備寫成斧與矛。英格蘭一方的投射火力同樣有限：家臣持大圓盾與雙手丹麥斧，以密集盾牆推進，民兵則以長矛列陣，只配少量弓手。真正把弓與弩放到戰術核心位置的，是阿爾弗雷德改革之後的堡壘體系，每座堡壘配守軍、武器庫與城頭射位，與壕溝、城牆構成防禦縱深，而弩在英格蘭自十、十一世紀起才逐漸固定為守軍編制。攻城用的重型器械在本次戰役中同樣罕見，大軍面對英格蘭城鎮時多以圍困、斷糧、襲擾為主。值得記錄的實物是雷普頓的發現：一八六七年與一八七九年的發掘在教堂東端發現北歐式葬地，坑內散置至少二百四十九人的遺骸，其中約八成為十五至四十五歲的男性；出土的維京式長劍現藏德比博物館。鄰近希思伍德的壙墓群則有約六十例火葬，這類火葬在英國極為罕見，被認為同屬這支部隊。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card belongs to the chariot-archer system of the Assyrian empire of the seventh century BC: a wooden core faced with horn, powerful and flat in trajectory, shot by archers standing in two-wheeled chariots to hold the enemy line down while the chariotry drove into the gap and heavy infantry finished the killing. None of this existed in England in 865. It belongs to a West Asian family of arms; the bow in Scandinavian hands was something else: a short bow of ash or yew, with horn and sinew-reinforced composite versions also used in the north, firing bone or stone-tipped arrows. The Vikings were not battlefield archers. Their missiles served mainly for hunting from the ship, for harassment and for scouting; what actually decided possession of the ground was the two-handed axe, the spear and the round shield, and the sagas too equip the sons of Ragnar with axes and spears. English missile strength was equally thin. Housecarls carried the large round shield and the two-handed Danish axe and advanced in a dense shield wall, while the fyrd fought with spears in line and only a few bowmen. What put the bow and the crossbow at the heart of the tactical picture was the burh system after Alfred's reforms: every fortified town was given a garrison, an armoury and firing positions on the curtain wall, forming a defensive depth with ditch and wall, while the crossbow only became a fixed part of the garrison order in England from the tenth and eleventh centuries onwards. Heavy siege engines were equally rare in this campaign; when the army faced an English borough it relied on blockade, on cutting supplies and on sudden raids. One set of physical finds deserves recording: the excavations of 1867 and 1879 at Repton uncovered a Scandinavian-style burial ground at the east end of the church, where the disarticulated remains of at least 249 people were scattered, about 80 per cent of them male and between fifteen and forty-five years old; a Viking-style sword from the site is now in Derby Museum. The nearby Heath Wood barrow cemetery has about sixty cremations, a rite so unusual in Britain that they too are attributed to this host.
tactics: 大軍的戰法是一套可以重複的機械：用船隊沿海峽與河口轉移，選一處可防守的營地過冬，把河流當作補給線，再以所奪城鎮為基地向四方突擊。八六五年秋在薩尼特島登陸，先以東英格蘭交出的馬匹換取通行，再沿東岸北上，十一月進抵約克；八六六年占約克後，翌年在諾丁漢受阻於威塞克斯與默西亞聯軍的圍城，轉而收取贖金；八六八年冬駐約克，八六九年回師東英格蘭，攻破城邑，殺死國王。八七一年自斯堪的納維亞來的援軍加入後，兵鋒指向威塞克斯，一月初八在阿什當敗陣；大軍其後轉戰倫敦、托克西、雷普頓，每到一處便以堡寨為冬營。英格蘭方面的戰術更成熟：守軍把人馬物資集中於設防城鎮，以高牆、深壕、封閉的城門拖住進攻者，靠矢石與守軍反擊消耗敵銳，再在城郊以盾牆反擊收復失地，八六七年威塞克斯與默西亞聯軍圍困諾丁漢即為守勢戰的代表。但阿爾弗雷德改革之後，戰略從被動固守轉為主動拒止：建立堡壘網，規定各郡民眾住在每座堡壘二十四公里即十五英里範圍之內，一旦有警即入城避難；重編民兵與家臣，設軍用道路連接各堡以便快速調兵；另造長於北歐船兩倍的軍船，專在海峽與河口攔截敵船登陸。八八四年之後，維京軍再無法在威塞克斯境內奪取據點，這支部隊最終在八九六年前後解散。
tacticsEn: The army's method was a repeatable machine. The fleets moved along the strait and the estuaries, chose a defensible camp for the winter, used the rivers as supply lines, and then struck outward in every direction from whatever town they had taken. In the autumn of 865 they landed on the Isle of Thanet, took the horses that East Anglia gave them in exchange for passage, moved north up the east coast and reached York by November. After occupying York in 866 they were held off the next year at Nottingham by a combined Wessex and Mercian army besieging the town, and took payment instead; they wintered at York in 868, returned to East Anglia in 869, carried the towns and killed the king. When the reinforcements from Scandinavia joined in 871 the host turned on Wessex and was beaten at Ashdown on 8 January; it then moved through London, Torksey and Repton, establishing a fortified camp for the winter at each. English tactics were the more mature. The defenders concentrated men and stores in fortified towns, holding the attacker at a high wall, a deep ditch and a closed gate, wearing the enemy down with missiles and return fire and then recovering the ground outside the walls in a counter-stroke of the shield wall; the siege of Nottingham in 867 by the Wessex and Mercian alliance is the classic case of this defensive form. After Alfred's reforms the strategy shifted from passive defence to active refusal: a network of burhs, with the people of each shire living within 24 kilometres, that is fifteen miles, of a burh and taking refuge in it when the alarm was raised; a reorganisation of the fyrd and the housecarls; military roads linking the burhs so that troops could move quickly; and warships built twice as long as the Scandinavian vessels, some with sixty oars, to intercept the enemy's landings in the strait and the estuaries. From 884 the Vikings could no longer seize a foothold in Wessex at all, and the host finally broke up around 896.
data: 關於大軍規模，史料沒有定論。薩伊瓦做過一張編年史所載船數的表，假設每艘北歐船最多載三十二人，由此推算大軍不超過一千人；薩迦則寫拉格納之子用運貨船載士，每船可載二百五十人。一九九〇年代有史家主張大軍為「數千人」量級，編年史本身並未給出數字。英格蘭法典《伊尼法典》（約六九四年）把「入侵軍」（here）定義為超過三十五人的襲擾隊，可見當時對大軍與地方民兵已有明確區分。可核對的實物與地點數字有幾組：雷普頓教堂東端合葬坑的遺骸至少二百四十九人，其中約八成為十五至四十五歲男性，二〇一八年布里斯托大學的碳十四測定把這些人骨集中定於九世紀晚期；希思伍德壙墓群約有六十例火葬。阿爾弗雷德的堡壘賦役簿（十世紀）按土地折算守軍數量，最大的一批堡要逾千人；據同一份賦役推算，威塞克斯可徵召的成年男子總數約二萬七千人，約佔成年男性人口的五分之一。北歐人在八八〇年代末抵禦維京的堡壘，以二十四公里為民眾避難半徑；八九二年回到福勒姆的北歐大軍已有二百五十艘船，同年另有一支八十艘船的隊伍駐紮米爾頓里吉斯，英格蘭編年史另記八七九年維京船隊在博沙姆遇大風覆沒。距離方面，自東英格蘭登陸點到約克約三百公里，維京軍沿河道與陸路行軍，冬季宿營使實際推進速度每季不過數十公里。
dataEn: The size of the army is not settled by the sources. Pete Sawyer tabulated the ship numbers recorded in the Chronicle, assumed that no Viking ship carried more than thirty-two men, and concluded that the army amounted to no more than a thousand; the sagas instead say that the sons of Ragnar used knorrs, each carrying two hundred and fifty men. In the 1990s several historians put the Great Heathen Army in the low thousands, and the Chronicle itself gives no figure at all. The law code of Ine of Wessex, issued about 694, defines a here, an invading army, as a raiding party of more than thirty-five men, which shows that contemporaries already distinguished the host from the local levy. Several groups of figures can be checked against the physical record. The mass grave at the east end of Repton church holds the remains of at least 249 people, about 80 per cent of them male and between fifteen and forty-five; radiocarbon work published by the University of Bristol in 2018 dated them all to the late ninth century. The barrow cemetery at Heath Wood contains about sixty cremations. The Burghal Hidage of the tenth century apportions garrisons by land, the largest burhs requiring more than a thousand men; on the same reckoning the adult male population of Wessex could furnish about 27,000 men, roughly a fifth of the adult males. The burhs that held the Vikings off in the later 880s drew their inhabitants to within 24 kilometres of safety. The force that returned to Fulham in 892 numbered 250 ships, and another warband of 80 ships encamped at Milton Regis in the same year; the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle separately records that a Viking fleet perished in a great storm at Bosham in 879. As for distance, it is roughly three hundred kilometres from the East Anglian landing point to York, and with the army marching by river and road and wintering on the way, its real rate of advance was a few tens of kilometres a season.
cause: 直接導火線在西面。八六二年西法蘭克王加固城鎮、扼守河道，北歐劫掠者難以再深入，於是把目光轉向英格蘭；而八五一年威塞克斯王艾塞爾伍爾夫曾在卡漢普頓擊敗北歐人，使北歐方面避開威塞克斯、改從東英格蘭下手。英格蘭自身的分裂更提供了機會：四個王國互不統屬，貴族捲入王位與地盤的爭奪，北方貴族托斯蒂格因領地被奪而叛逃，正是靠這種內部裂縫，聯軍才能為自己找到內應。經濟與人口因素同樣重要。整個北歐在八六〇年代面臨土地壓力與氏族分裂，年輕的戰士集團大批出海，劫掠已成為季節性的生業；法蘭克各國長久以金銀贖買北歐人，掠奪所得又反過來養活更多船隊，形成滾雪球式的擴張。英格蘭這邊則經歷饑荒與瘟疫後的凋敝，八七五至八七七年大饑再次襲來，城鄉的守備與生產能力都低於同時期的北歐。八四五年巴黎被劫、八四○年卡漢普頓等戰役，已經顯示英格蘭的城鎮與河道對北歐船隊同樣脆弱。深層原因則在王權與信仰層面：北歐諸王在基督教化過程中，把一部分戰士轉為以劫掠為生的集團以換取自身權力，而英格蘭的教會網絡與貴族體系尚能以共同的王權與信仰凝聚防禦。薩迦把這次入侵說成是為拉格納·洛德布洛克復仇，但英格蘭編年史並無此說法，史家也認為復仇說缺乏同期證據。
causeEn: The immediate trigger lay to the west. In 862 the West Frankish king fortified his towns and held his rivers, which made it hard for the Norse raiders to strike inland, and they turned their eyes on England instead; and in 851 Æthelwulf of Wessex had beaten the Northmen at Carhampton, so the Norse avoided Wessex and approached by way of East Anglia. The internal division of England gave them a better opening still: the four kingdoms were not united to one another, the aristocracy was caught in disputes over thrones and lands, and the northern earl Tostig, deprived of his territory, turned traitor. It was precisely through such fissures that the invading host found someone to work with inside England. Economic and demographic factors mattered as much. Across the whole of the north in the 860s there was pressure on land and a breaking up of kindreds, and young warrior groups went to sea in numbers; raiding had become a seasonal trade. The Frankish kingdoms had for years met the Norse with silver, and the plunder paid for more ships, so that the enterprise grew like a snowball. England in turn was worn out by famine and plague; a great famine came again in 875 to 877, and the capacity of town and countryside to defend itself was lower than that of the contemporary north. The sack of Paris in 845 and the fighting at Carhampton in 840 had already shown that English towns and rivers were as vulnerable to northern fleets as French ones. At a deeper level the causes lie in kingship and religion: as the northern kingdoms were converted, their rulers turned part of the warrior bands into plunderers in order to buy power for themselves, whereas in England the network of churches and the aristocracy could still rally defence around a common king and a common faith. The sagas present the invasion as vengeance for Ragnar Lodbrok, but the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle says nothing of the kind, and historians regard the revenge story as unsupported by contemporary evidence.
impact: 維京大軍沒有佔領整個英格蘭，卻改變了它的版圖。北方與東部落入丹麥人之手：哈爾夫丹在八七六年把北安普敦的土地分給部眾耕種，八七九年後古斯魯姆在東英格蘭受洗為王、駐於諾丁罕一帶，約克、林肯、諾丁漢、萊斯特與北安普敦這五城及其周邊逐步形成丹麥法區；英格蘭王國的另一半留在威塞克斯手中，兩種法律、兩種稅制、兩種語言在此後數百年並行。阿爾弗雷德因這場戰爭重塑了英格蘭的國防與治理：堡壘網、軍用道路、常備守軍、民兵徵發與海峽巡邏船隊取代了舊有的臨時徵召；英格蘭編年史的撰寫也從阿爾弗雷德時代開始連續，修士阿塞爾以拉丁文記下戰局，後來譯成古英語傳世；教會在動亂中被保住，壟斷了文字與行政，並與王權結合，使威塞克斯得以自稱英格蘭的守護者。長遠的影響延伸到語言與血統：北歐移民與薩克遜人混居，形成古諾斯語與英語的混合，今日英語中的 many、they、sky 等詞即來自古諾斯語。維京人的船隊把歐洲的航線連成一體，也把劫掠的傳統傳給了後來的諾曼人，一○六六年諾曼征服之所以能夠成功，部分原因正是英格蘭在此前兩百年已被北歐人改造過。北歐海盜文化最終在八九六年前後解體，其成員或落地為農民，或渡海回到丹麥與愛爾蘭。
impactEn: The Great Heathen Army never occupied the whole of England, but it redrew the map. The north and the east fell to the Danes: Halfdan shared out the land of Northumbria among his men in 876 so that they would plough it and live on it, and after 879 Guthrum, baptised as Æthelstan, ruled in East Anglia from around Nottingham, while York, Lincoln, Nottingham, Leicester and Northampton, the Five Boroughs, and the country around them gradually formed the Danelaw. The other half of England stayed in Wessex, and for several centuries two legal systems, two tax systems and two languages ran side by side. Alfred rebuilt English defence and government in response to this war: the network of burhs, military roads, standing garrisons, the calling out of the fyrd and a patrolling fleet in the strait replaced the old ad hoc levies. The writing of the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle also becomes continuous from Alfred's time; Asser set the course of the war down in Latin, and it was later turned into Old English and handed on. The Church survived the disorder, kept hold of writing and administration, and was bound to the kingship, which allowed Wessex to call itself the guardian of England. In the long run the effects reached into language and blood: Norse settlers and Saxons mixed, Old Norse and English blended, and modern English words such as many, they and sky come from Old Norse. The Viking fleets tied Europe's sea routes together and passed the habits of raiding on to the Normans, so that part of the reason the Norman Conquest of 1066 could succeed is that England had already been remade by the Northmen over the preceding two centuries. The raiding culture itself dissolved around 896, its members either settling as farmers or sailing back to Denmark and Ireland.
result: 結果是維京人沒有佔領整個不列顛群島：大軍在威塞克斯碰壁，又遇上八九六年前後的解散，轉為散兵。英格蘭保住核心，反攻在九十年代展開：八九二年福勒姆的二百五十艘船大軍重返英格蘭並在肯特阿普爾多爾登陸，隨後在米爾頓里吉斯徘徊；八九六年維京軍在威塞克斯境內再也站不住腳，軍隊解體，一部分散往東英格蘭與北安普敦，一部分渡海回到塞納河一帶。但佔領留下了兩種制度：北方與東部的丹麥法區，以及威塞克斯的英格蘭王國。前者與法蘭西北部的諾曼底保持貿易與宗族聯繫，日後成為諾曼征服的落腳點；後者經由堡壘賦役、民兵制度與編年史傳統，長成日後的英格蘭王國。八六五年之前，英格蘭只是四個互相爭鬥的小王國；此戰之後，它在兩條河流與兩套制度的拉扯中逐漸成為一個國家。
resultEn: The outcome was that the Vikings did not occupy the whole of the British Isles. The host met its match in Wessex, broke up around 896, and dispersed. England kept its core, and the counter-offensive opened in the 890s: in 892 the host of 250 ships from Fulham returned to England and landed at Appledore in Kent, and lingered afterwards at Milton Regis; by 896 the Vikings could no longer hold a position in Wessex, the army dissolved, part of it spreading to East Anglia and Northumbria and part sailing back across the sea to the Seine. The occupation nevertheless left two systems behind: the Danelaw in the north and east, and the English kingdom in Wessex. The first kept trade and family ties with Normandy in northern France and would later serve as the landing place for the Norman Conquest; the second grew, through the burh levy, the militia system and the chronicle tradition, into the English kingdom of later ages. Before 865 England was only four small kingdoms quarrelling with one another. After this war it began, between two river systems and two sets of institutions, to become a single country.
